movie.title: Nightcrawler
movie.overview: When Lou Bloom, desperate for work, muscles into the world of L.A. crime journalism, he blurs the line between observer and participant to become the star of his own story. Aiding him in his effort is Nina, a TV-news veteran.

facts: You might be interested to know that Lou Bloom isn't working alone in his intense L.A. crime journalism endeavors. He's actually aided by Nina, who is specifically described as a seasoned TV-news veteran!
Before Lou Bloom becomes entangled in the dark side of L.A. crime journalism, his initial drive is surprisingly simple: he's desperate for work! It's a stark beginning for such a complex character.

Lou Bloom takes his role in L.A. crime journalism to an unusual level, not just reporting but actively blurring the lines between watching and participating. This extreme approach eventually makes him the star of his very own narrative!
